description: This file defines theme-related styles and constants for a Flutter application, including color schemes, button styles, input decorations, and overall theme configurations for light and dark modes, based on the Ocean Professional style.

classes.name: _OceanColors
classes.description: Defines color constants used across themes, including primary, secondary, error, text, and surface colors for both light and dark palettes.

methods.name: oceanHeaderGradient
methods.description: Creates a gradient decoration for headers or containers using theme colors.

methods.name: _cardShape
methods.description: Returns the shape for card widgets with rounded corners.

methods.name: _outlinedBorder
methods.description: Creates input borders with consistent radius and specified color.

methods.name: _filledButtonStyle
methods.description: Provides a button style with rounded corners and smooth transitions for elevated buttons.

methods.name: _lightScheme
methods.description: Constructs a ColorScheme object tailored for light mode based on Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: _darkScheme
methods.description: Constructs a ColorScheme object tailored for dark mode based on Ocean Professional palette.

methods.name: getAppTheme
methods.description: Generates the ThemeData for the light theme of the app, applying colors, typography, and component styles.

methods.name: getDarkTheme
methods.description: Generates the ThemeData for the dark theme of the app, applying colors, typography, and component styles.
